questions.prompt: What does «Этот суп очень вкусный» mean in English?
questions.explain: Очень intensifies the adjective вкусный toward the high end of the scale, giving very tasty.

questions.prompt: Which degree adverb fits: «Этот кофе ___ горький» (this coffee is too bitter — an unwanted excess)?
questions.explain: Слишком means too or excessively, marking горький as beyond the acceptable level.

questions.prompt: How would you say "I almost finished the work" in Russian?
questions.explain: Почти means almost or nearly, marking закончил as not quite complete.

questions.prompt: In «Он совсем не понимает меня», what does совсем не express?
options: He does not understand me at all.
questions.explain: Paired with не, совсем не means not at all, a total negation.

questions.prompt: In «Я купил только хлеб», what does только do?
options: Restricts focus to хлеб — bread and nothing else was bought.
Marks bread as surprising, like even bread.
Says he bought too much bread.
questions.explain: Только means only and restricts focus to the word right after it, here хлеб.

questions.prompt: Which degree adverb is the odd one out — three mean roughly a small/slight degree, one does not?
questions.explain: Чуть, слегка and едва all mark a slight or minimal degree; совершенно means completely or utterly.

questions.prompt: What does «Это более или менее понятно» mean?
options: This is more or less clear.
This is not clear at all.
questions.explain: In the fixed phrase более или менее, более pairs with менее to mean more or less.

questions.prompt: Which adverb best fits a bookish, formal register meaning "very/highly" as a synonym of очень, e.g. «Это ___ интересный вопрос»?
questions.explain: Весьма is a bookish, formal synonym of очень meaning very or highly.

questions.prompt: In «Даже дети знают эту песню», what role does даже play?
options: It restricts focus to children only.
It says almost all children know it.
It is a focus particle meaning even, marking children as the surprising case.
questions.explain: Даже is a focus particle meaning even, signalling that the next item — дети — is surprising.

questions.prompt: What does «Он чуть не опоздал на поезд» mean?
options: He was a little late for the train.
He was only slightly late for the train.
He was definitely late for the train.
questions.explain: The set phrase чуть не before a verb means almost or nearly did — here a near-miss.

questions.prompt: How would you say "This is a rather difficult question" (moderate degree, not extreme)?
questions.explain: Довольно means rather or fairly, softening сложный to a moderate degree.

questions.prompt: Which adverb signals emphatic negation and almost always pairs with не, as in «Я ___ не устал» (not tired at all)?
questions.explain: Вовсе almost always pairs with не; вовсе не means not at all and strengthens the denial.

questions.prompt: What does «Я едва успел на поезд» mean?
options: I barely (only just) caught the train.
I almost missed but did not catch it.
I was too late for the train.
questions.explain: Едва means barely or only just; успел shows the success was very close to failing.

questions.prompt: In «Именно это я хотел сказать», what does именно do?
options: Pinpoints это as exactly the thing meant.
questions.explain: Именно means exactly or precisely, singling out это as the very thing meant.

questions.prompt: Which adverb is the bookish, literary equivalent of только, as in «Я ___ хотел спросить» (I merely wanted to ask)?
questions.explain: Лишь means only or merely, a more literary equivalent of только.

questions.prompt: What does «Ты совершенно прав» mean?
questions.explain: Совершенно intensifies прав to an absolute degree, meaning absolutely right.

questions.prompt: Which degree adverb fits a high-intensity reading: «Я ___ устал сегодня» (very much / heavily tired, common with verbs and pain)?
questions.explain: Сильно means strongly or very much, marking intense, heavy tiredness.

questions.prompt: What does «Я вполне доволен результатом» mean?
options: I am quite (fully) satisfied with the result.
I am barely satisfied with the result.
I am too satisfied with the result.
I am not at all satisfied with the result.
questions.explain: Вполне means quite or fully, marking доволен as completely satisfied.

questions.prompt: In «Мне особенно нравится зима», what does особенно express?
options: Winter is the only season liked.
Winter especially stands out as a favourite.
Winter is not liked at all.
questions.explain: Особенно means especially, marking зима as standing out among others.

questions.prompt: Which adverb is the bookish equivalent of так, meaning "so / to such a degree", as in «Почему ты ___ печален?»?
questions.explain: Столь means so or to such a degree, a formal, literary equivalent of так.
